newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex Jan-July crude, natgas output up vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Pemex Jan-July crude, natgas output up vs yr ago.

text.p: State oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Tuesday that its crude oil output in the first seven months of 1996 was an average 2.86 million bpd, up 6.6 percent or 476,300 bpd from the same period last year.
Pemex said in a statement that crude exports in January-July were 1.53 million bpd, up 229,700 bpd from a year previously.
Natural gas output was 4.265 billion cfd, up 16 percent or 588 million cfd over the same period.
Pemex said oil output in January-July consisted of 1.35 million bpd of heavy Maya crude, 920,000 bpd of light Isthmus and 581,000 bpd of superlight Olmeca.
The main producing region was the Bay of Campeche, which accounted for 74.5 percent of total crude output.
Natural gas output consisted of 3.563 billion cfd of associated gas and 702 million cfd of non-associated gas.
